# Cloud Modular

> Precision-engineered modular construction for Western Australia

Cloud Modular delivers architecturally designed, factory-built modular buildings certified to Australian standards. We serve developers, builders, and organisations across Perth, Western Australia, and nationally.

## Company Overview

- **Industry**: Modular Construction / Prefabricated Buildings
- **Location**: North Perth, Western Australia 6006
- **Website**: https://cloudmodular.com.au
- **Contact**: info@cloudmodular.com.au

## What We Do

We manufacture precision-engineered modular buildings offsite in controlled factory environments, then deliver and install them on-site. This approach offers:

- 50% faster construction timelines
- Up to 20% cost reduction
- 70% less landfill waste
- Full Australian Building Code compliance

## Services

- Commercial modular buildings
- Multi-residential developments
- Health and aged care facilities
- Education and community buildings
- Infrastructure projects
- Hotels and accommodation

## Target Markets

- Residential developers
- Commercial builders
- Healthcare providers
- Education institutions
- Government and councils
- Hospitality operators

## Key Differentiators

1. Australian Building Code certified modules
2. Factory-controlled quality assurance
3. Third-party engineering inspections
4. Design-to-delivery coordination
5. Offsite manufacturing reduces site disruption
